text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! I did it! I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, I'm so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, wasn't I so cool? I got first
place and
everything!

text_block_list.name: Everyone from the Shopping District
text_block_list.text: Uraraaa! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's my friends from the shopping
district!
Helloooo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, we're gonna make you a
celebration
feast!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! I want some super fluffy rice
then,
please!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! They look so happy! I'm so glad
I won!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The more I race, the happier they'll be,
huh?
Which race am I running in next?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? As long as I can run, I'll do any of
them!
choice_data_list: ウララが出たいレースはない？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's just like her to say. I'd rather she
have a
specific race she wants to shoot
for, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In any case, if she wants to enter the
Arima Kinen,
then there's only so many
races to choose from.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to run in the Arima Kinen,
she needs
to get used to races that are
longer than a mile.
To that effect, the
race I have in mind is only a
hundred
meters longer than this one, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell my shopkeeper friends I'm
entering the Elm
Stakes then!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What?! That far?! I guess there's no way
they
could come, then.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh well! I got first, so it's okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, and I'm gonna be the star of
tonight's
show! I gotta dance my heart
out!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey! Time to prepare for my
concert!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara goes back to the waiting
room, and I
head backstage.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow! There's so many people! Way
more than
usual!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And I'm gonna be in the center this time!
Oh, my
heart is pounding already!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I wi―huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara's gaze lands on an
Umamusume with
an unhappy face. She
ran in today's race, too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-Urara... Yeah, I'm fine, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But you look so sad! The concert's about
to start.
You're not happy?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, so many people came out to
watch us!
Where's that smile you always
have?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: How can I smile right now?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I finally got into a G1 race... I finally had
a
chance! But I blew it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I wanted to win! But I didn't even make it to the center stage! I'm a loser!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
How can I smile at a time like this? I'm
so, so
angry! I can't smile!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Angry?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, forget it. I'm fine. I'll put on a
happy face
for the show.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Next time, I will be center stage!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...She left.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She's smiling all the time. She's
super nice
to everybody, too...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I've never seen her like this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara seems shocked. Seeing a new
side of
her friend like this must've really
impacted her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Okay, I gotta give it my all!
choice_data_list: ライブ、そろそろ始まるぞ
ライブ、そろそろ始まるよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara regains her composure and
heads
toward the stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the second half of the show, I
join the
audience and see that Special
Week has come to
watch.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! Urara's trainer! Hello!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Urara looks like she's having so much fun
dancing!
Just watching her gets me
excited, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I love coming to see her
concerts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like Special Week says, Haru Urara's
charm is
in how much energy she exudes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why everyone loves her. No
matter how
many times she fails, she's
always smiling.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Urara always tries so hard.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
I want to see her smiling on the Arima
Kinen stage
too. I hope she qualifies...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I overhear a familiar voice. Looking over,
I see
the shopkeepers from the shopping
district
talking while watching the
performance.

text_block_list.name: Kind Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
But can she even enter the Arima Kinen
at this
rate? Her results aren't great...

text_block_list.name: Happy Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's anything we can do to
help...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, the show's almost over, huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When you go back, please tell Urara I
said the
show was fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head back to the waiting room with the

shopkeepers' conversation still fresh in
my mind.
